one_line: A relatable joke as persistent text over a real task, with the reveal saved for the last second.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a woman in a long brown dress bends over a big cardboard box in a living room, pulling parts out. No speech. Centred text: 'Pov: אם אתה נשוי למזל שור יש לך 2 דקות...' (full text in q8).
q1_hook.why: The full joke setup is on screen from frame one while a visible task is already moving, so the viewer reads and then waits for the punchline (H1, T3, H5). It speaks to a defined group, people with a Taurus partner, in a couple moment they know (K3).

beats.what: She bends over the big box and pulls parts out; the joke text is already up
beats.why: Setup text and action together; no intro.

beats.what: Unfolds the stroller frame, fits a wheel; a baby sits on the floor from 0:04
beats.why: Quick cuts compress the work and keep the build moving.

beats.what: Close-up of the handle, then the finished cream stroller; she adjusts the hood
beats.why: First payoff: the finished product looks good.

beats.what: She stands beside it, visibly pregnant, a hand on her belly
beats.why: The punchline: she did it herself, and she is pregnant.

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption first line: 'מזל שור בקהל? להתפקד!' (Taurus in the audience, report in). The joke itself is something to send to a partner, but no send is asked.
q2_flow.why: At 8 s the Reel is short enough that the punchline in the last second is reached by most viewers (R1, R4). A new picture every 1 to 2 s keeps it moving (R3). The couple joke is the kind a person sends to a partner (R5), and the caption gives a one-word reply (R6).

q3_cta.what: None in the video. Caption: 'מזל שור בקהל? להתפקד!'. No link, code, keyword or product ask.
q3_cta.why: The caption ask is easy to answer from one's own life (a star sign), so it is not bait (R6, C2), though it is a closed 'raise your hand', not an open question (C5). Nothing points to the stroller, so a viewer who liked it has no next step (C6).

q4_shown.what: A large anex shipping box and a stroller frame from 0:01; a wheel fitted at 0:04 with a baby on the floor; the finished cream stroller with carrycot at 0:06; the pregnant creator beside it at 0:07. No price, no features.
q4_shown.why: The product is a prop in the story, and the brand shows only on the box, so brand talk is close to zero (K5, C7). It shows the stroller handsome and finished but says nothing about what it does for a parent (H2).

q5_edit.what: 6 shots in 8 s (average 1.4 s), quick straight cuts near 1, 4, 5, 6 and 7 s that compress the assembly; no speed ramp seen. One persistent text, no subtitles. Ends on the reveal shot, no end card.
q5_edit.why: Short cuts suit an 8 s runtime and make the build feel fast, which is the joke's point (E2, R3). The length fits a single visual moment (R2). It stops on the punchline with no tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: A couple joke: a pregnant woman assembles the stroller herself instead of waiting. Shows a stroller as a prop for viewers who relate to waiting on a partner.
q6_topic.why: The humour comes from a recognisable couple and pregnancy moment, not a gag unrelated to family life (K3). It builds to one amused reveal (K1). It is easy to send to a partner (R5).

q7_filmed.what: Phone on a tripod or held by a second person, mostly static wide and medium shots at eye level in a bright living room with a large mirror. One short handheld close-up at the handle. One adult, a baby on the floor incidentally.
q7_filmed.why: Static wide shots show the whole action clearly (F8). A real home with real boxes gives the native look (H8, F7). The stroller is small in most frames and only fills the shot at 0:06 (F4).

q8_text.on_screen: One text for the whole 8 s, centred in the upper third, three lines, white bold serif, no box: 'Pov:' then 'אם אתה נשוי למזל שור יש לך 2 דקות לעשות את מה שביקשה אחרת היא תעשה את זה בעצמה!'. About 85 characters. No subtitles, no logo, no other text.
q8_text.caption: 'מזל שור בקהל? להתפקד!' with emoji. One short line, five hashtags (#מזלשור, #אמאברשת, #דחייתסיפוקים, #עגלהבסטייל, #anexeli), two brand tags (@anex_baby, @babystarisrael). No disclosure word.
q8_text.why: The text carries the whole joke, so it works muted, and it sits in the upper third clear of the buttons (T1, T4, T3). It stays all 8 s, long enough to read, though in three lines (T5). The caption has no product words (T7), and no disclosure shows despite two brand tags (T8).

weak_points: No product information, so the viewer cannot tell what the stroller does; no next step to the brand; no disclosure word beside two brand tags; the joke depends on a star-sign audience; three lines of text.
lumebook_takeaway: Film an 8 s hands-only skit: one joke sentence as persistent text over the book being unpacked and opened, with the reveal in the last second.
not_verified: Audio: no speech (the machine 'תודה רבה' is an artefact), music not established. Whether the stroller was gifted or paid. Who filmed it. Whether the joke drives the plays. Correction: no face is visible in the first frame (she is bent over the box), and the brand shows on the box 0:01 to 0:04.
